fullTextZH: 大家好今天要给大家讲两个故事。
fullTextEN: Hello everyone, today I want to tell you two stories.

fullTextZH: 上个星期我参加了一个在线研讨会，
fullTextEN: Last week I attended an online seminar,

fullTextZH: 有一个很重要的语言学家也来了，
fullTextEN: A very important linguist also came,

fullTextZH: 他给我们讲了两个故事，
今天我把他的故事告诉你。
fullTextEN: Today I will tell you his stories.

fullTextZH: 第一个故事是他在学中文，
fullTextEN: The first story is about him learning Chinese,
He said his Chinese is not very good.

fullTextZH: 他要有很多的可理解输入。
fullTextEN: He needs a lot of comprehensible input.
He finally had a chance to speak Chinese,
It was at a subway station,

fullTextZH: 他看到了一个亚洲女人，
好像别人听不懂她说话的样子，
fullTextEN: It seemed like others couldn't understand what she was saying,

fullTextZH: 但是我可以努力地去帮帮她，
fullTextEN: but I can try hard to help her,

fullTextZH: 这个女人突然非常非常激动，
fullTextEN: This woman suddenly became very, very excited,
It's great that you can speak Chinese.

fullTextZH: 他就是用他会的所有的中文，
fullTextEN: he used all the Chinese he knew,
to help this woman buy a ticket,

fullTextZH: 然后呢他们一起在火车上聊天。
fullTextEN: Then they chatted together on the train.
He said he is a grandfather,

fullTextZH: 所以他当然最喜欢聊天的话题，
fullTextEN: so of course his favorite topic to chat about,

fullTextZH: 看了很多他孙女的照片。
他觉得自己的中文不太好，
fullTextEN: He felt his Chinese was not very good,

fullTextZH: 但是他们还是聊了很多，
fullTextEN: but they still talked a lot,

fullTextZH: 而且他帮助了这个女人。
我觉得非常非常非常对。
fullTextEN: I feel it's very, very, very right.

fullTextZH: 当你学习一个语言的时候，
fullTextEN: When you are learning a language,

fullTextZH: 如果你专注的是你自己，

fullTextEN: How will this person see me?

fullTextZH: 怎么学了这么多年，中文还是这样。
fullTextEN: How come after so many years, my Chinese is still like this.

fullTextZH: 但是如果你专注在另外一个人身上，
fullTextEN: But if you focus on another person,
How can I help this person.

fullTextZH: 我可以怎么让这个世界更好。
fullTextEN: How can I make this world better.

fullTextZH: 其实都不需要让这个世界更好，
fullTextEN: Actually, there's no need to make the world better,

fullTextZH: 但是你可以去帮助一个人，
fullTextEN: but you can help one person,

fullTextZH: 即使是一件很小的事情，
fullTextEN: even if it's a very small thing,
then you will gain a lot of happiness.

fullTextZH: Steven Krashen在帮助这个女人的时候，
fullTextEN: When Steven Krashen was helping this woman,
he said he wasn't anxious at all,

fullTextZH: 因为他的专注点不是自己，
fullTextEN: because his focus wasn't on himself,

fullTextZH: 他的专注点在另一个人身上，
fullTextEN: his focus was on another person,
Okay, this is the first story.

fullTextZH: 第二个故事发生在埃塞俄比亚。
fullTextEN: The second story takes place in Ethiopia.

fullTextZH: 为什么他要去埃塞俄比亚，
总之他去了埃塞俄比亚，
和一些埃塞俄比亚人在一起。

words.pinyin: āi sāi é bǐ yà rén

fullTextZH: 他呢，自己也通过听他们说话，
fullTextEN: He, through listening to them speak,

fullTextZH: 他会跟他慢慢地说埃塞俄比亚语。
fullTextEN: He will slowly speak Amharic with him.

fullTextZH: 然后呢他去了一个聚会，
fullTextEN: Then he went to a party,

fullTextZH: 那还有很多埃塞俄比亚人，

words.pinyin: āi sāi é bǐ yà rén

fullTextEN: Imagine he is a white person,

fullTextZH: 大家觉得你在这里太奇怪了，
fullTextEN: Everyone thinks you are too strange here,

fullTextZH: 而且你也不会说我们的语言，
fullTextEN: And you can't speak our language,

fullTextZH: 他听到一个埃塞俄比亚的男人，

fullTextEN: "What is that white person doing here?"

fullTextZH: 他就去跟这个男人说话，
fullTextEN: He then went to talk to this man,

fullTextZH: 然后他们成为了好朋友。
他说很重要的是幽默感，
fullTextEN: He said that having a sense of humor is very important,

fullTextZH: 幽默感需要很高级的语言才能实现。
fullTextEN: A sense of humor requires advanced language skills.
My Chinese is not good enough,

fullTextZH: 所以我说中文的时候不幽默。
fullTextEN: So I'm not humorous when I speak Chinese.

fullTextZH: 我们特别需要一个幽默感，
fullTextEN: We especially need a sense of humor,

fullTextZH: take it easy，就是你可以笑一笑自己，
fullTextEN: Take it easy, you can laugh at yourself,
You can make friends with people.

fullTextZH: 虽然你的中文并不完美，
fullTextEN: Although your Chinese is not perfect,

fullTextZH: 但是幽默感真的可以帮助到你。
fullTextEN: A sense of humor can really help you.
So the point he wants to make is,

fullTextZH: 就是没有人在乎你完不完美，
fullTextEN: It's just that no one cares if you're perfect or not,

fullTextZH: 但是如果你愿意换一个角度，
fullTextEN: But if you are willing to change your perspective,

fullTextZH: 可能这些痛苦就没有了。
因为没有人在乎你完不完美，
fullTextEN: Because no one cares if you're perfect or not,

fullTextZH: 你对这两个故事有什么感觉。
fullTextEN: What do you feel about these two stories?
